title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Falls 5.5% as Board Hires Probe Counsel (Nov 10)
summary: Nvidia stock (NVDA) fell 5.47% to $168.89 on Nov 10 as its board named Wachtell Lipton and Joon H. Kim to lead the probe involving CEO Jensen Huang.
body_markdown:
## Why Nvidia Stock Fell


Financial media tied the drop to the board's investigation involving Huang. In a[statement dated November 10](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-the-independent-members-of-the-nvidia-board) , the independent members of the board said they had retained Kim, a former acting US Attorney for the Southern District of New York, and Wachtell Lipton to conduct "a thorough and independent investigation." The statement gave no timeline for results.


The probe began on Sunday, November 8. According to the[board's November 8 statement](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors) , a committee of independent directors, assisted by outside counsel, will examine reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The board said it had no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and that Huang supports the review.


As reported by[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/nvidia-wachtell-lipton-huang-affair.html) , Nvidia[fell more than 4% on Monday](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-10-2026/) , and investors worry the scandal could force Huang out, though a company representative said he intends to remain CEO without interruption. Per[NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/business/corporations/ex-prosecutor-probe-jensen-huang-chinese-spy-affair-nvidia-rcna608628) , the shares have lost more than 10% since Monday's open, erasing nearly $500 billion in market value.[The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-nov-10-223502212.html) linked the wider market's decline to hotter-than-expected inflation data.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Nvidia's board said on November 8 that it had no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.
- AMD and Broadcom rose on the day, and the Motley Fool said that split points to company-specific problems rather than weaker AI chip demand.
- A company representative said Huang intends to keep leading Nvidia without interruption, as reported by CNBC.


### Risks


- CNBC reported that investors worry the scandal could force Huang out, and the board's latest statement set no timeline for the investigation.
- NBC News reported that President Trump said on Monday the FBI was also looking into the matter.
- After the two-day slide, the stock sits 2.81% above its 52-week low of $164.27.


The next confirmed event is the[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) for Nvidia's fiscal third quarter of 2027, which ended October 25. According to the company's[conference call notice](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873) , the results call is on Tuesday, November 17, at 5 p.m. Eastern.
